text: The Patriots' roster took a hit this week as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle, forcing the team to place him on injured reserve while promoting punter Mitch Wishnowsky to the 53-man roster and adding tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad—moves that come on the heels of a dominant 20-3 defensive performance over the Steelers, where TreVeyon Henderson punched in a touchdown and the Patriots' man coverage scheme had Pittsburgh's Aaron Rodgers in constant distress, even as the offense continues to search for the rhythm that fueled last season's Super Bowl run. Looking ahead to Sunday's 1 PM ET matchup at Jacksonville's Everbank Stadium, all eyes will be on whether Drake Maye can execute the balance of patience and aggression that the coaching staff demands against a fresh opponent, though the loss of Onwenu along the offensive line makes that task considerably more challenging.
